disposition.test: skips a work item with no start date and still totals the others

facts.F1: Bug #6705 (reported by Gunnar R. Fischer on Slack): for one team, 'Work Items Total Work Item Age Over Time' shows nothing. The tooltip reads 'NaN days total (40 items) - Click for details'; the details list the right items. Cause found: an in-progress item with no start date is counted in progress from its created date by the server, but the client gets startedDate = null and sums NaN. Maintainer decision: the server sends the fallback start date for such an item (the frontend should not care), and if a start date can still be null, the frontend handles it gracefully.
facts.F13: When a start date is still missing, the Total Work Item Age Over Time chart skips that item and still shows a proper chart of the others
facts.F14: A work item with no start date is skipped by the Total Work Item Age Over Time chart, which still totals the other items and draws its line
facts.F15: Render the Total Work Item Age Over Time chart for days whose in-progress items include one with startedDate null or undefined and others with start dates
facts.F16: Each day's total is the sum of the ages of the items that have a start date, and its item count leaves the skipped item out; no value or tooltip shows NaN
facts.F17: A day's total or tooltip shows NaN, the line is missing, or the item without a start date adds to the total or the count
facts.F18: An in-progress item with no recorded start date shows, as its start date, the same created date the age is counted from.
facts.F19: Does not see items that have a recorded start date, nor items in other states, and cannot show the date displayed for a start date that is later edited.
facts.F2: The Total Work Item Age Over Time chart draws its line for every team, even when an in-progress item has no recorded start date.
facts.F20: When an item has no start date, the Total Work Item Age Over Time chart still renders, plots the other items, and shows no missing-value gap or NaN for the skipped item.
facts.F21: Does not see a dataset where every item lacks a start date, nor whether the skipped item is counted in the chart's totals or legend.
facts.F22: Show the Total Work Item Age Over Time chart for two days whose in-progress items include one with no start date (empty on one day, missing on the other) and two with start dates
facts.F23: Each day's total is the sum of the ages of the items with a start date (4 days and 6 days), the tooltip reads the same total with an item count of 2, and no value shows NaN
facts.F24: The reader sees a drawn line with proper totals and item counts; the item without a start date is left out
facts.F25: The chart totals every item but treats a missing start date as age zero in the total while still counting it in the item count
facts.F26: Build the work item DTO for an item in progress that has no start date and a created date
facts.F27: The DTO's start date equals the item's created date
facts.F28: The chart receives a start date for every in-progress item, so no total turns into NaN
facts.F29: Start date set to the current day or to a fixed date, only checked for being non-null
facts.F3: An in-progress item with no recorded start date is sent to the client with its created date as its start date, the same date the server already counts its age from
facts.F30: Build the DTO for an in-progress item with both a start date and an earlier created date
facts.F31: The DTO keeps the item's own start date
facts.F32: Items that did start are aged from their real start
facts.F34: Build the DTO for a To Do item with no start date and a created date
facts.F35: The DTO has no start date
facts.F36: An item that has not started is not shown as started
facts.F37: A fallback to created date for a state category other than To Do and Doing, such as Done, is not observed
facts.F4: An in-progress item with no start date reaches the client with its created date as its start date
facts.F5: Build the work item DTO for an item in a Doing state whose StartedDate is null and whose CreatedDate is set
facts.F6: The DTO's StartedDate equals the item's CreatedDate; a To Do item with no start date still has none, and an item with a start date keeps its own
facts.F7: The DTO's StartedDate is null for the in-progress item, or a To Do item gains a start date
